title: Isolating Which Components Drive the Gain

scenes.narration: Starting from our baseline model at sixty-four percent, rotary embeddings lift accuracy by four point eight percent. Adding normalized attention adds another three point six, hard weight decay drops point nine, and curriculum scheduling reaches seventy-five point seven in the full system.

visual.heading: Ablation Waterfall on Reasoning Accuracy
visual.caption: Each bar begins from the previous cumulative accuracy so true contributions stay visible.

scenes.narration: Measuring latency instead, uncached decoding takes forty-eight milliseconds. Key-value caching saves sixteen milliseconds, fused kernels trim nine more, eager logging overhead adds three back, bringing fast serving down to twenty-six milliseconds.

visual.heading: Inference Latency Reduction Breakdown
visual.caption: Negative latency deltas are colour-coded green because lower latency is better.
